name: WorldPop REST API
summary: Keyless REST catalogue API for WorldPop gridded population datasets: projects, categories and per-country dataset records with download links.
description: The WorldPop Hub REST API lists projects (population counts, age and sex structures, births, urban change, covariates and more), the datasets in each category and per-country records with metadata, DOI and file URLs for the GeoTIFF rasters. It is a catalogue API: the rasters themselves are downloaded from the linked files.

endpoints.summary: List datasets (categories) of a project, e.g. pop
Dataset records with metadata and file URLs, filterable by country

agent_notes: Discover with /data, then /data/pop, then /data/pop/wpgp?iso3=AUS. Without the iso3 filter wpgp returns all 5,221 records in one response. Each record has a files array of download URLs and a doi. The hub docs page was not found at /api; the endpoint shapes above come from querying the API.
caveats: No public API docs page was found (hub.worldpop.org/api returned 404); parameters were derived by probing and only iso3 was tested.
Responses (HTTP and PHP debug lines) include server details in headers; the body is clean JSON.
An older api.worldpop.org service (statistics/tasks) returned PHP deprecation output and was not verified.

verification.notes: Example executed 2026-11-11 (200, no CORS header); /rest/data and /rest/data/pop also 200.
